description: Year 4 theological working drafts; require individual editorial review. Not published.

comparisonReferences: Deeper Life Bible Church doctrinal teachings and Daily Manna
Mountain of Fire and Miracles Ministries prayer teaching

entries.title: Strength for Today — Daily Discipleship
entries.reflection: Scriptural encouragement should join prayer to practical kindness. Consider a request for help in the light of this teaching. Express mercy through practical care.
entries.prayer: Father, anchor my hope in Christ as I face a request for help; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The evidence of renewal is not excitement alone but a life redirected toward Christ. Consider an uncertain choice in the light of this teaching. Seek counsel grounded in the Scriptures.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my devotion to Your Word as I face an uncertain choice; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Restitution and honest conduct demonstrate a conscience yielded to God. Consider a season of waiting in the light of this teaching. Make amends for wrong conduct where appropriate.
topics.prayer: Father, purify my motives and actions as I face a season of waiting; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Scriptural encouragement should join prayer to practical kindness. Consider a request for help in the light of this teaching. Express mercy through practical care.
topics.prayer: Father, anchor my hope in Christ as I face a request for help; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer includes worship, confession, thanksgiving, and intercession. Consider someone who has offended you in the light of this teaching. Read the passage in its biblical context.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to intercede faithfully as I face someone who has offended you; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance means turning away from sin and putting faith in the Saviour. Consider an opportunity to show mercy in the light of this teaching. Trust God's wisdom while doing your duty.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face an opportunity to show mercy; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trusting God includes honesty, accountability, and keeping commitments. Consider a responsibility at home in the light of this teaching. Pursue peace without compromising truth.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith as I face a responsibility at home; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Spiritual experiences must be weighed against Scripture and lived in love. Consider someone who needs encouragement in the light of this teaching. Tell the truth with humility.
topics.prayer: Father, empower me for holy witness as I face someone who needs encouragement; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Every believer is called to compassionate personal evangelism. Consider a neighbour in need in the light of this teaching. Choose patience instead of harsh words.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a compassionate soul-winner as I face a neighbour in need; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Forgiveness calls for grace without excusing persistent wrongdoing. Consider a time of prayer in the light of this teaching. Offer a word of encouragement.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love in truth as I face a time of prayer; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: The Word of God calls hearers to faithful obedience. Consider a temptation to complain in the light of this teaching. Remember the example of Christ.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Scripture as I face a temptation to complain; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Self-control and patience are marks of godly wisdom. Consider a period of spiritual dryness in the light of this teaching. Receive correction without pride.
topics.prayer: Father, give me discernment and wisdom as I face a period of spiritual dryness; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: The hope of Christ's return calls believers to holy watchfulness. Consider a need to listen in the light of this teaching. Pray for those with whom you disagree.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me ready for Christ's return as I face a need to listen; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — Daily Discipleship
entries.reflection: Private prayer should accompany public service rather than being neglected. Consider a challenge to persevere in the light of this teaching. Seek counsel grounded in the Scriptures.
entries.prayer: Father, teach me to intercede faithfully as I face a challenge to persevere; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Churches seeking spiritual awakening must honour God's Word and care for souls. Consider a chance to speak truth in the light of this teaching. Keep a promise despite inconvenience.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my devotion to Your Word as I face a chance to speak truth; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Heavenly Key emphasises purity before spiritual power; character matters. Consider an opportunity to serve in the light of this teaching. Bring the promise of Scripture to mind.
topics.prayer: Father, purify my motives and actions as I face an opportunity to serve; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: The resurrection of Jesus gives believers hope beyond present trials. Consider an invitation to witness in the light of this teaching. Speak about Christ with compassion.
topics.prayer: Father, anchor my hope in Christ as I face an invitation to witness; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Private prayer should accompany public service rather than being neglected. Consider a challenge to persevere in the light of this teaching. Seek counsel grounded in the Scriptures.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to intercede faithfully as I face a challenge to persevere; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Justification is grounded in Christ's atonement, not human achievement. Consider a chance for reconciliation in the light of this teaching. Make amends for wrong conduct where appropriate.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face a chance for reconciliation; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Believers should seek wisdom before making major decisions. Consider a moment of temptation in the light of this teaching. Express mercy through practical care.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith as I face a moment of temptation; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to bear witness to Jesus Christ. Consider an unnoticed duty in the light of this teaching. Read the passage in its biblical context.
topics.prayer: Father, empower me for holy witness as I face an unnoticed duty; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: A clear gospel witness speaks of Christ's cross, resurrection, and repentance. Consider a demanding responsibility in the light of this teaching. Trust God's wisdom while doing your duty.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a compassionate soul-winner as I face a demanding responsibility; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian unity is strengthened by patience and doctrinal faithfulness. Consider a decision requiring counsel in the light of this teaching. Pursue peace without compromising truth.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love in truth as I face a decision requiring counsel; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: A persuasive slogan must never replace careful Bible study. Consider a need to examine motives in the light of this teaching. Tell the truth with humility.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Scripture as I face a need to examine motives; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Discernment requires prayer, humility, and attention to Scripture. Consider a temptation to show off in the light of this teaching. Choose patience instead of harsh words.
topics.prayer: Father, give me discernment and wisdom as I face a temptation to show off; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Heavenly Key teaches the rapture and resurrection of the saints. Consider an uncertain choice in the light of this teaching. Offer a word of encouragement.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me ready for Christ's return as I face an uncertain choice; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith as I face a misunderstanding; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The mission to reach nations must remain truthful and humble. Consider a moment of gratitude in the light of this teaching. Make amends for wrong conduct where appropriate.

topics.prayer: Father, keep me ready for Christ's return as I face a chance to speak truth; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face a temptation to show off; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith as I face an uncertain choice; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to bear witness to Jesus Christ. Consider a season of waiting in the light of this teaching. Keep a promise despite inconvenience.
topics.prayer: Father, empower me for holy witness as I face a season of waiting; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.prayer: Father, make me a compassionate soul-winner as I face a request for help; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

topics.prayer: Father, help me love in truth as I face someone who has offended you; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Scripture as I face an opportunity to show mercy; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
